maya: Heads-up: starting header-based feature gate canary for mobile SDKs today. Rolling to 5% android, 2% ios. Need quick check on client-side fallbacks and semver check.
jun: sounds good. confirm which header key and expected value? also how do we target old clients that don't send headers?
sam: For mobile we don't always have version header. Recommend: enforce a `X-Client-Version` header from SDK, else we rely on client id and platform mapping in routing for canary. Do we have a mapping for old app versions? @katy do you have that table?
katy: I can export mapping. Quick note: iOS versions <2.4 have a bug in streaming so must be excluded. I'll attach list later.
maya: Header is `X-Redwood-Feat`. value `client_flags=mobile_fast_path` (we'll match by substring). Semver: clients >= 2.5.0 should enable behavior. Plan: server checks header first, then if missing or version <2.5.0, fall back to safe path.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary policy created — feature_gate/mobile_fast_path — scope: mobile, android 5%, ios 2% — start_time 2028-06-12T14:00Z
jun: One more: in SDK we should avoid throwing on unknown header—just no-op. Is that already the case in v2.5+?
sam: Yes Android SDK v2.5 no-op. For iOS we added safe guard in 2.6. So need to exclude 2.5 from iOS canary until 2.6 released.
maya: OK change: ios target 0% for now. Update canary to android 5% only. Also add server-side kill switch: env REDWOOD_FEATURE_MOBILE_FAST_PATH=false to immediately disable.
katy: :thumbsup: I'll update mapping and open a tiny PR to bump iOS gating to 0.
jun: I'll add tests to server check: cases: header present + matching, header present but bad value, missing header + version ok, missing header + old version => fallback. Share code snippet for check.
jun: ```python
def should_use_fast_path(req):
    hdr = req.headers.get("X-Redwood-Feat","")
    if "mobile_fast_path" in hdr: return True, "header"
    v = parse_semver(req.headers.get("X-Client-Version","0.0.0"))
    if v >= Version("2.5.0"): return True, "version"
    return False, "fallback"
```
maya: Perfect. Can someone ping docs/devex for SDK note? Also QA needs a checklist: reproduce with header override, without header, and on old clients.
sam: I'll file QA ticket and add test device lab cases.
katy: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/432 — adds X-Client-Version in android header (staged).
maya: Great. I'll update the rollout playbook and mark this thread resolved once PRs landed and tests pass. Target check-in in ~2h.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: follow the rollback runbook if error rate increases >0.5% for 5m
